Voting weight is earned, not granted: each address solves a sequential delay puzzle seeded by a random subset of last epoch's outputs. Fixed depth means one machine yields one per round.

k puppets mean k serial sequences on k machines, never a batch: seeds are unknowable ahead, so a farm pays the same wall-clock per identity, cost flat in N, while an honest operator pays one round per epoch.

The attacker buys a horizon, not a discount: every extra marble is carved alone; jade-standard weight takes verifiable cost, not credentials.
